results.note: Widens the ATX heading indent boundary from 0-3 spaces to 0-4, a plausible off-by-one that admits headings CommonMark would treat as indented code.
Drops the `filter` keyword from PowerShell block recognition, a plausible simplify-the-alternation refactor that quietly stops matching PS filter blocks.
Drops hyphen support from the `function name` form's capture group while leaving the `name()` form unchanged, an inconsistent normalization loss between the two alternatives.
Removes the decorator-attachment guard clause: pending is overwritten by every decorator instead of remembering only the first, so a def attaches to its last decorator rather than its first.
Changes the brace-close rule in _brace_starts from checking the line OPENS with `}` to checking it ENDS with `}`, so a line like `x = { }` at column 0 would wrongly close the function block.
Boundary flip on _overlaps' empty-span (a1 == a2) branch: an anchor point sitting exactly at region.end no longer counts as overlapping that region.

Weakens needed_rung's anchored test from all() to any(): an edit spanning several regions is now rung-1 if just ONE touched region has an anchor, instead of requiring every touched region to have one.
